source: G. D. Kerr et al., Physical Review A 5, 2523–2527 (1972), Figure 1, solid Univ. of Tennessee curves
method: Pixel-centre readings of n and k from the original figure, not fitted particle extinction. Painter dashed curves, legends and annotation arrows excluded.
lowAbsorptionNote: Below 7.4 eV the plotted k is too close to zero for a reliable logarithmic digitization. The comparison retains the tabulated Segelstein UV absorption there, joins to Hale at 200 nm, and identifies this limited reconstruction in its notes.
